name: Fire Sticker
summary: Flickering cartoon flame sticker: use for hot, trending, lit or on-fire moments.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 380 px wide at s = 1

params.name: color
params.note: flame colour; the inner flame is always yellow

params.name: anim
params.note: flicker = the flame wavers, sway = leans side to side

params.name: popIn
params.note: springs in over the first 10 frames

author: krakujs
